criteria.evidence: From the iPhone (iphone-15-plus, tailnet online, Wi-Fi off / mobile network) via Open Minis at the single HTTPS entry https://alvin.tail63d20f.ts.net:8443/mcp, both services were called and matched: everything-stdio_1mcp_get-sum {a:2,b:3} -> 'The sum of 2 and 3 is 5.'; everything-http_1mcp_get-sum -> 'The sum of 2 and 2 is 4.' (and {a:2,b:3} -> 5). MagicDNS resolved alvin.tail63d20f.ts.net -> 100.119.224.46.
criteria.source: iPhone Open Minis manual run (operator-reported output); host verify: tailscale status (iphone-15-plus online), tailscale serve status (443/8443 tailnet-only), curl host->8443 = 200
criteria.limitations: Operated on a real iPhone over the tailnet; the exact radio (Wi-Fi vs cellular) is confirmed by the operator, not machine-observable from the host.

criteria.evidence: The authorized tailnet device is reachable (iPhone calls succeeded). The private entry is served tailnet-only (tailscale serve, no funnel), so non-tailnet sources are rejected; the admin page (3230) and the Gateway (3213) listen only on 127.0.0.1, so the management page stays local-only. Direct host->:8443 returns 200 while :3213 is not tailnet-reachable by design.
criteria.source: Get-NetTCPConnection: 127.0.0.1:3230 and 127.0.0.1:3213; tailscale serve status (tailnet only); iPhone success
criteria.limitations: Non-tailnet rejection rests on the tailnet-only Serve mode and loopback binding; no external/non-tailnet device was used to demonstrate a denial.

criteria.evidence: With the Gateway stopped via the management page (/api/gateway/stop), the iPhone call through the same entry failed distinguishably: ping and call both returned {"error":"HTTP 502: ","code":"CONNECTION_ERROR","server":"mcp-hub"}. After restarting the Gateway (/api/gateway/start), ping returned {"ok":true,"elapsed_ms":538} and the tool call returned the expected result.
criteria.source: Host stop/start via Hub API; iPhone Open Minis operator-reported outputs; host curl host->8443 = 502 then 200
criteria.limitations: Demonstrated service-stop failure and recovery; the 'host offline' (network-down) variant is covered by the same tailnet path being unreachable when the host is disconnected and was not separately performed.

criteria.evidence: No change was made to Open Minis, and no request replay or remote-wake mechanism was added; the iPhone simply calls the private HTTPS entry and receives MCP results, with offline reported as an explicit CONNECTION_ERROR rather than a false success.
criteria.source: No Open Minis/ iOS changes; product change limited to app/src/gateway-controller.js (externalUrl passthrough + transient start retry)
criteria.limitations: Design constraint verified by the absence of such mechanisms, not by a separate automated assertion.

changes.summary: Pass --external-url to @1mcp when configured, so the Gateway accepts the public Host header of a private HTTPS entry (Tailscale Serve) alongside loopback; and retry --background once after the state settles when it fails transiently ('did not become ready'), removing the stop/config-reload race that made the apply/restart occasionally fail.
Adds a test covering the transient not-ready start failure settling and retrying once, then succeeding.
Test hub sets gateway.externalUrl = https://alvin.tail63d20f.ts.net:8443 so the private entry's Host header is accepted.
